description: This file defines the PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator class responsible for managing the lifecycle of a PeekabooBridge host, setting up socket paths and symlinks, and coordinating services related to the Peekaboo bridge for macOS. It also includes the internal service provider class for various automation and UI services.

classes.name: PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator
classes.description: Manages the connection and lifecycle of the PeekabooBridge host, including socket path setup, symlink handling, and service coordination.

classes.name: OpenClawPeekabooBridgeServices
classes.description: Provides various automation and UI services used by the Peekaboo bridge, such as permissions, screen capture, automation, window management, and dialogs.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the PeekabooBridge host.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the PeekabooBridge host if it’s running.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes and starts the host if it is not already active.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlinks
methods.description: Creates symlinks for legacy socket paths.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlink
methods.description: Creates a symlink at a legacy socket path if necessary.

methods.name: currentTeamID
methods.description: Retrieves the current code signing team ID.

methods.name: makeSocketPath
methods.description: Constructs a socket path within a specified directory.
